about.title: About Ponyo
about.heading: One home for plush,
about.intro: Ponyo is a plush marketplace for people who love soft things. We bring together premium plush from around the world, so you can find bears, bunnies, kitties and characters in one place, in every size.
about.intro2: And when bigger is better, there is Domina: our giant plush line, with XL and Giant sizes up to 120 cm.
about.v1_body: Limited and hard-to-find plush you will not see everywhere, picked for their character.
about.v2_body: Soft, well-made plush, with the details you need shown on each product page.
about.v3_body: Our giant plush line, with XL and Giant sizes up to 120 cm, for hugs that fill a room.
about.closing_body: Browse the full collection, or search for exactly what you have in mind.

faq.title: FAQ & Shipping
faq.sub: Answers about ordering, delivery, sizes and plush care. Can't find what you need? Our team is happy to help.
faq.ordering_a1: Pick your plush, add it to your cart and check out. After you order, we confirm your plush and prepare it for delivery. You will get email updates about your order.
faq.ordering_q2: Which payment methods can I use?
faq.ordering_a2: The payment methods available to you are shown at checkout.
faq.ordering_q3: Can I change or cancel my order?
faq.ordering_a3: Contact us as soon as possible with your order number and we will do our best to help before your plush is dispatched.
faq.shipping_q1: When will my plush be dispatched?
faq.shipping_a1: Each listing shows its own dispatch time, because plush can ship from different places. Check the dispatch time on the product page before you order.
faq.shipping_a2: Enter your address at checkout to see the delivery options and costs available for your location.
faq.shipping_a3: Shipping costs depend on your location and the size of your plush. You will see the exact cost at checkout before you pay.
faq.shipping_q4: How can I track my order?
faq.shipping_a4: When your order ships, we email you an update. If tracking is available for your delivery, it is included in that email.
faq.sizes_a1: Every plush is sorted into a size: Mini, Classic, Big, Domina XL or Domina Giant. The exact measurements are shown on each product page.
faq.sizes_a2: Domina is Ponyo's giant plush line, with XL and Giant sizes up to 120 cm. Perfect for hugging, decorating a room, or a gift that makes an entrance.
faq.sizes_q3: Do giant plush cost more to ship?
faq.sizes_a3: Usually yes, because big plush need bigger boxes. The delivery cost for your order is shown at checkout.
faq.care_q1: How do I clean my plush?
faq.care_a1: Care instructions can differ by plush, so check the care tab on the product page. For everyday freshening up, gently spot clean with a damp cloth and let it air dry.
faq.care_q2: Is this plush suitable for children?
faq.care_a2: Age and safety details are shown on the product page when available. If you are unsure, message us before ordering and we will check for you.
faq.help_q1: Something is wrong with my order. What should I do?
faq.help_a1: Contact us with your order number and a photo of the issue, and we will sort it out with you.
faq.help_a2: Please contact us before sending anything back, so we can guide you through the right steps for your order.
faq.help_a3: Use our contact page and our team will reply as soon as we can.
faq.contact_body: Send us a note about your plush, sizing or delivery and we will get back to you.
